headline: One o'clock. The brick keeps the sun.
body: The shade has gone past the kerb and into the road. A bus idles at the stop; the open window upstairs takes the same air. Someone downstairs has set a cup on the step and not come back for it.

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: cup on the step, bus at the stop

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: sun on brick, shade in the road
